text:
oncall-bot: PAGE: [INCIDENT P1] Elevated 5xx + high p95 timeouts observed on /v1/generate. Trigger: 7% 5xx rate, p95 latency ~90s. Pager: @Sara Ng. Incident link: https://incidents.redwood.internal/INC-2026-045 :rotating_light:

Sara Ng: I'm on it. Starting triage. Quick status: customer-facing errors or internal only?

Miguel R.: customer-facing — multiple customers reporting 502/504 on generation calls, correlation ids attached in support tickets. First spike seen ~2026-02-18T11:10:xxZ. Gateway logs show a lot of upstream 504s and gateway 502s with x-retry-count: 2..3.

Dina Patel: Adding initial notes. Correlation IDs sampled from support: cor-97ff2a8b, cor-97ff33a1, cor-100a4c2b. Traces linked show long wait at runtime connection handoff, then upstream timeout.

Alex Chen: I'm pulling traces now. No deploys recorded in last hour (checked deploy-bot + release-log). K8s events: cluster autoscaler increased pods by 3 at ~11:12Z.

ops_lead: Confirmed no active deploys. We did have a config roll on redis-client on Feb 17 but that was days ago.

Sara Ng: Miguel/Dina — can you paste a couple of raw gateway log lines for one of the correlation ids? also any runtime logs for same id.

Miguel R.: paste logs below (sanitized):

```
2026-02-18T11:16:54.123Z gateway  INFO request_id=cor-97ff2a8b path=/v1/generate status=502 upstream_status=504 upstream_host=runtime-prod-3 x-retry-count=3 latency_ms=90214
2026-02-18T11:16:54.122Z gateway  DEBUG request_id=cor-97ff2a8b headers={"x-retry-count":"3","x-client-retries":"2"}
2026-02-18T11:16:43.007Z runtime   WARN request_id=cor-97ff2a8b pool=gpupool-5 status=timeout reason="upstream timeout waiting for worker" queue_ms=89000
2026-02-18T11:16:43.009Z runtime   ERROR request_id=cor-97ff2a8b worker=worker-27 msg="kernel stall, OOM?" details="evicted kvcache"
```

Dina Patel: Timeline so far (quick):
- 11:10Z: first minor deviation (p95 ~ 2x baseline)
- 11:12Z: autoscaler kicked, +3 runtime pods
- 11:15Z: p95 climbs to ~60s
- 11:16Z: errors surge (502/504), retries observed at gateway
- 11:20Z: start of paging (this thread)

Hypotheses to track in-thread:
1) Runtime pods hitting memory pressure -> kernel stalls -> long stalls causing gateway timeouts and retries.
2) KV/prefix cache eviction causing cold starts and long tokenization/compilation steps.
3) Gateway retry amplification: client retries + gateway retries magnify load and trigger OOM cascade.

Alex Chen: I'm posting trace links and a grep command to correlate: `kubectl logs -l app=runtime -n prod --since=30m | jq -r \"select(.request_id==\"cor-97ff2a8b\")\"` — example trace: https://traces.redwood.internal/trace/cor-97ff2a8b

ops_lead: Recommend immediate mitigation: 1) enable fallback route to quantized/model-compact variant for the route to reduce per-request memory and latency, 2) throttle retries at gateway (set x-client-retry-limit=1) to avoid amplification. Approving canary now? :eyes:

Sara Ng: Please run the fallback canary on 5% traffic to the quantized variant. Also add gateway header to prevent retries: `--set gateway.retry_limit=1` on config. Miguel, help me roll the canary.

Miguel R.: On it. Steps I'm running:
```
# create canary route
redwoodctl routes create-canary --route /v1/generate --variant quantized-small --percent 5 --reason "mitigate timeout surge"
# set gateway retry limit
kubectl patch cm gateway-config -n infra --type merge -p '{"data":{"retry_limit":"1"}}'
```

oncall-bot: ACTION LOGGED: canary-created by Miguel R. -> route /v1/generate -> quantized-small @ 5% at 2026-02-18T11:28:02Z

Dina Patel: Uploading a small sample of runtime logs and flamegraphs to s3: s3://redwood-incident-logs/INC-2026-045/runtime-sample-11-16.tar.gz

Alex Chen: After canary flip (5%) p95 dropped to ~40s for that 5%, overall p95 still high but error rate decreased from 7% to 4% in 10 minutes. Looks promising.

Sara Ng: Good. Keep canary running and increase to 20% if metrics continue improving. Also start aggregating correlation_id -> error mapping. Use this command to cross correlate: `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-logs/gateway/2026-02-18.gz - | zgrep cor-97ff | wc -l`

Miguel R.: Found additional pattern in logs: many requests have `x-retry-count` header added by a client-side SDK and gateway-side retries are stacking. Eg: client sends 2 retries, gateway also retries on 5xx -> results in 6 attempts total for some requests. This looks like retry amplification.

Dina Patel: Runtime sample shows frequent `evicted kvcache` around same times. Example block:
```
2026-02-18T11:15:59.887Z worker-27 INFO evicting kvcache size=312MB free_mem=120MB
2026-02-18T11:16:10.001Z worker-27 INFO kvcache cold-start latency_ms=47230
2026-02-18T11:16:43.007Z worker-27 ERROR stall reason="kernel-stall-detected" stack="..."
```

Alex Chen: So combined hypothesis: KV cache eviction/cold-starts increase per-request latency -> gateway timeouts -> retries amplify load -> further memory pressure -> worker stalls.

ops_lead: For immediate mitigation:
- Keep canary at 20% (increase now)
- Disable gateway-side automatic retries for /v1/generate (we set retry_limit=0 in prod like for other heavy routes)
- Patch SDK guidance: ask integrations to set client retry limit to 1 (we can email customers later)

Sara Ng: I'm bumping canary to 20% now and applying retry_limit=0 for this route.

Miguel R.: Commands executed, canary now 20% at 11:34Z. Gateway retry_limit patched to 0 for /v1/generate. Monitoring...

oncall-bot: NOTE: config-change by Sara Ng at 2026-02-18T11:34:26Z - canary 20% /v1/generate; retry_limit=0

Alex Chen: Metric update 5m after increase: overall p95 down to 28s, error rate down to 1.8%. Alive traces show fewer kernel stalls. Looks like mitigation working. :thumbsup:

Dina Patel: Uploading full log archive and initial flamegraphs -> s3://redwood-incident-logs/INC-2026-045/full-archive-11-16.tar.gz

Sara Ng: Good job team. Next steps (RCA track):
- Owner: Miguel R. -> collect complete set of correlation ids and map to runtime pod memory events (due EOD).
- Owner: Dina Patel -> reproduce kvcache eviction pattern in staging with controlled load (due tomorrow).
- Owner: Alex Chen -> prepare tracing summary + timeline for postmortem (due tomorrow morning).
- Owner: ops_lead -> propose long-term mitigations: smarter retry dedupe, op-level circuit-breaker, and memory headroom policy (due next week).

ops_lead: I'll also open a scheduled change to increase default worker reservation and add a soft limit to prevent mass eviction.

Sara Ng: I'll create the postmortem ticket and assign owners. Please attach the S3 artifacts and this thread.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated (customer impact reduced) at 2026-02-18T11:40:10Z. RCA in progress.

Miguel R.: Quick note for RCA — include these correlation ids: cor-97ff2a8b, cor-97ff33a1, cor-100a4c2b, cor-100b9cc0. Uploaded to S3.

Dina Patel: tagging for follow-up: @platform-observability for improved kvcache metrics, @sdk-eng for retry guidance.

Sara Ng: Closing the page — we'll keep monitoring 24h. Postmortem in tickets: INC-2026-045-POSTMORTEM. Thanks team. :lock:
